name: Sphere Tracing with Composite SDF and Adaptive Sampling
aliases: SDF Sphere Tracing with Letter/Arc Geometry
definition: A ray marching algorithm that uses Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) to trace rays through a scene composed of primitive shapes, character segments, and arcs. It handles multiple hit types (DIFFUSE, LETTER, ARC, SUN) and uses adaptive sampling with variance-based convergence for path tracing.
summary: Sphere Tracing with Composite SDF and Adaptive Sampling renders primitives, letters, and arcs via unified SDFs and variance-based adaptive sampling, differing from uniform tracing by dynamic step sizing and from volumetric methods by surface-based path tracing.
